name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: An animated dialog for React and shadcn, with alert dialogs and nested dialogs, built on Base UI.

meta.details: A modal dialog and alert dialog on Base UI that rise 8px at 0.96 on a spring over a blurred scrim and leave 4px in 160ms. Nested dialogs step their parent back; alert dialogs answer an outside click with a 1.5% bump.
